Providers may return (T, func() error) or (T, func() error, error). Generated
code guards nil, releases in reverse construction order, and joins failures
into the run error.

package web

import "net/http"

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() (*DB, func() error, error) { db := &DB{}; return db, func() error { return nil }, nil }

type Cache struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewCache(db *DB) (*Cache, func() error) { return &Cache{}, nil }

type Index struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewIndex(c *Cache) (*Index, error) { return &Index{}, nil }

type H struct {
	DB    *DB
	Cache *Cache
	Index *Index
}

//fabrik:http GET /x
func (h *H) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		webDB, webDBClose, err := web.NewDB()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if webDBClose != nil {
			defer func() {
				err = errors.Join(err, webDBClose())
			}()
		}
		webCache, webCacheClose := web.NewCache(webDB)
		if webCacheClose != nil {
			defer func() {
				err = errors.Join(err, webCacheClose())
			}()
		}
		webIndex, err := web.NewIndex(webCache)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webH := &web.H{
			DB:    webDB,
			Cache: webCache,
			Index: webIndex,
		}

		r := router.New()

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/x", webH.Get)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
